entries.surface: Canonical V1/V2 PDA derivation and account binding
entries.notes: Pure derivation and binding checks are covered locally; this is not proof of a deployed program or live accounts.
The compatibility artifact reaches the program through the pinned local ProgramTest harness and passes the six lifecycle cases.
Fixed-seed tests cover fee arithmetic, deadline boundaries, and initialization role/hash/mint constraints; they are not coverage-guided fuzzing or an independent audit.

entries.surface: Fresh SBPF v3 release-artifact lifecycle execution
entries.notes: The fresh v3 artifact is rejected before instruction execution with UnsupportedProgramId by the pinned Solana 2.3.1 ProgramTest loader. A compatible validator/runtime probe is required before release approval.
The route returns HTTP 501 and the server only accepts ESCROW_MODE=sandbox; it cannot sign, broadcast, or move real funds.

entries.surface: Approved deployment identity, network manifest, and live cluster
entries.notes: The read-only on-chain verifier can prove a supplied manifest with an Ed25519 approval matching a separately supplied trusted approver key against finalized RPC evidence, but no deployment manifest, funded authority, approved RPC, or release approval was supplied; it fails closed rather than inventing one.
